rows.text: When the Golden Banana Planet split into several pieces due to a forbidden experiment, Dr. Primitive merely chuckled and pulled out the Supreme Glue from his pocket, sticking the planetary fragments back together. No one knew why Dr. Primitive initially invented this overpowered adhesive until one day, while evading Rangers' pursuit, he deliberately scattered some mass-produced Supreme Glue across the universe for passing merchant ships to collect. This genius creation that could "fix anything" instantly caused an uproar across the cosmos. Some used it to build houses, while others installed bombs. One even tried to mend a broken relationship, and when that failed, they settled for gluing themself to their partner, never to part again.
